sections.overview: PHASE-ZERO ("Observatório de Vidro Mineral") is a map-first geospatial InSAR triage workstation for tailings dam monitoring. At initial load, 100% of the viewport stays open for the interactive MapLibre canvas paired with a single floating glass capsule (FloatingHud) at the top edge and a compact guidance prompt pill along the lower safe area. Diagnostic charts, Mann-Kendall trend indicators, and the interactive 18x18 (80m x 80m) 3D terrain mesh surface inside ObservatorySheet only after the operator selects a dam marker, calibrated scenario, catalog search result, or custom coordinate on the map.
sections.colors: All semantic tokens live in frontend/app/globals.css under --pz-* custom properties resolved dynamically via CSS light-dark() alongside explicit <meta name="color-scheme"> and @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) synchronization.
sections.typography: Display & UI uses Figtree (400, 500, 600, 700) via --font-sans. Technical telemetry uses JetBrains Mono (400, 500, 600) via --font-mono strictly paired with .tabular-nums on coordinates, ISO date spans, coherence thresholds, deformation velocity values (mm/yr), and SVG chart axis ticks.
sections.layout: Full-viewport WebGL canvas powered by maplibre-gl (^4.7.1) with OpenFreeMap (positron/dark/liberty), Esri World Imagery + Labels, and AWS Terrarium DEM tiles. FloatingHud fits on one horizontal row at 1440px and folds scenarios below lg (1024px). ObservatorySheet uses responsive mobile tabs under lg and a 12-column desktop grid once hasSelection is true.
sections.elevationAndDepth: .pz-glass applies blur(18px) saturate(1.25) and .pz-glass-strong applies blur(22px) saturate(1.3) over var(--pz-shadow). Entry reveals use CSS @starting-style transitions (340ms sheet, 280ms popover) collapsing under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
sections.shapes: Pill radius 9999px for chips and switches; 24px (rounded-3xl) for ObservatorySheet; 16px (rounded-2xl) for cards, HUD dock, and modals; 12px (rounded-xl) for chart and 3D canvas wells; 8px (rounded-lg) for inputs and micro toggles.
sections.components: FloatingHud, ObservatoryMap, ObservatorySheet, DiagnosticsPanel, TerrainViewport3D, TimeSeriesChart, ThermoLoopChart, DataSourceBadges, TokenModal.
sections.dosAndDonts: Keep initial state unobstructed until a target is chosen; pair JetBrains Mono with .tabular-nums on numeric telemetry; preserve accessible status ink contrast in both Light and Dark themes; avoid hardcoded dark fills in SVG/Canvas; keep mobile bottom pills clear of MapLibre zoom/attribution controls; preserve the official NISAR provisional data footer disclaimer.
